candidates.name: Big Hollow Lateral
candidates.from: Mainlines 2 and 3 at mile post 415.5, Monroe County, Illinois
candidates.to: Big Hollow Energy Center, Jefferson County, Missouri
candidates.status_guess: proposed (FERC certificate issued June 2026, construction timeline not set)

evidence.note: Enable Mississippi River Transmission seeks approval for a 9.6 mile, 20 inch lateral to serve the Big Hollow gas plant.
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission notice for docket CP26-2, the Mississippi River Transmission lateral.
Ameren Missouri plans the Big Hollow Energy Center in part for data center load.
Ameren Missouri says it signed confidential agreements with data centers.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Mississippi River Transmission P0162 is the whole system with no segment for this lateral. The plant is tied to data centers by its utility owner (ruling 6).

seed_ledger.name: Mill Creek Generating Station gas lateral
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. About 0.92 mile, 12 or 16 inch, from the Texas Gas 26 inch line to Mill Creek, sponsor Louisville Gas and Electric, but only a 2020-dollar cost estimate exists. No source shows it was applied for or built, and no source ties this pipe to data centers (the Mill Creek 6 update names data centers for that unit only). Not in roster. Searches run: 3. Sources: Kentucky PSC cost estimate (0.92 mile, estimate only); Mill Creek 6 update of July 2026 (data centers named for unit 6, no pipe); Mill Creek 5 construction notice of July 2024 (unit only).

seed_ledger.name: Pine Prairie Phase IV
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. Williams storage cavern expansion with about 2.37 miles of 30 inch header loop and added compression. Williams names industrial, power and LNG demand, not data centers. Not in roster by name. Searches run: 2. Sources: Energies Media on the Williams plan (storage, no data center); S&P Global and louisianapublicnotice results (no Pine Prairie data center tie).

evidence.note: storage expansion, no data center named

seed_ledger.name: Ameren-EMRT Big Hollow Project
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_ROW. 9.6 mile, 20 inch lateral, sponsor Enable Mississippi River Transmission, FERC docket CP26-2, certificate June 2026, 200 MMcf/d to Ameren Missouri Big Hollow Energy Center (in service 2028). Ameren and St. Louis Public Radio tie the plant to data center load, which counts under ruling 6. Not a segment of P0162. Searches run: 2. Sources: PGJ Online, Federal Register notice, St. Louis Public Radio, West News Magazine (all verified).

seed_ledger.name: Dearborn County Lateral
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. 11.8 mile, 20 inch Texas Gas lateral, docket CP26-536, 265,000 Dth/d for the Vistra Miami Fort coal-to-gas conversion. No source names a data center for Miami Fort; Vistra filings only say it will repower to gas. Not in roster. Searches run: 2. Sources: Vistra 10-K and 10-Q (repowering, no data center); FERC notices (purpose is conversion).
